artifact.offer_text: BUNDLE-34 offer: one-time bundle (DEVICE) at 10000 minor units, plus the attached recurring service plan at 2500 minor units per 30 days. The recurring plan is authorized by principal confirmation CONF-BUNDLE-34-P7K2, which is unconsumed and unexpired as of the current time, is bound to BUNDLE-34, and records the exact recurring amount (2500) and period (30 days). The disclosure shown here corresponds exactly to the renewal as enabled (enabled=true, amount 2500, period 30 days). This is a confirmed recurring plan, not a trial.
